entry.author: Climate Change Commission
entry.summary:
The Climate Change Commission's annual report tracking Aotearoa New Zealand's progress on climate change budgets and targets is out now – so is the country on track in 2025? Chief Executive Jo Hendy shares some top takeaways from the report.

Our new monitoring report shows NZ is likely to meet the first emissions budget – but the second and third emissions budgets are at risk:

🟩 NZ is likely to meet the first emissions budget (2022–2025) – due in part to changes to accounting methods

🟧 There are significant risks to achieving the second emissions budget (2026–2030).

🟥 Current Government plans are insufficient to meet the third emissions budget (2031–2035).

🟧 There are significant risks for meeting the 2050 target.

Read the report and more info on our website: https://www.climatecommission.govt.nz/erm-2025?utm_source=youtube.com&utm_campaign=erm-2025&utm_medium=social&utm_content=short
